statement_en: In mandarin fish, high dietary carbohydrate generally reduced feeding: in one 8-week trial, daily feed intake was unchanged between 2.4% and 16.5% carbohydrate but fell significantly between 16.5% and 30.1%, and another study reported anorexia in fish fed an 8% carbohydrate diet, with sustained hyperglycemia inferred. statement_zh: 鳢类中的鳜鱼（Siniperca chuatsi）饲喂高碳水化合物饲料总体上会抑制摄食：一项8周试验中，碳水化合物在2.4%至16.5%之间日摄食量无显著变化，在16.5%至30.1%之间显著下降；另一项研究报道，喂8%碳水化合物饲料的鳜出现厌食，并推测其存在持续高血糖。随碳水化合物升高，生长先升后降，最高碳水组的日增重和蛋白质保留率较低、饵料系数较高；不过有一个时间点的日摄食量各组间差异不显著。

statement_en: In mandarin fish, moderate dietary choline (400–1600 mg/kg) raised expression of the appetite gene agrp, and 800 mg/kg raised feed intake rate, though only that one group differed significantly in feed intake and npy did not change. Very high choline (3200 and 6400 mg/kg) pushed appetite genes the other way (higher pomc and cart, lower agrp), raised energy-stress gene expression at 6400 mg/kg, and was linked to poorer growth.
statement_zh: 在鳜鱼中，饲料添加适量胆碱（400–1600 mg/kg）可上调食欲基因agrp的表达，800 mg/kg时摄食率显著提高，但只有该组的摄食量显著高于对照组，npy表达无变化。胆碱添加过高（3200和6400 mg/kg）则使食欲调控向相反方向变化（pomc、cart上调，agrp下调），6400 mg/kg还使能量应激相关基因表达升高，并与生长下降有关。

grouping.reason: All members describe dietary choline supplementation at different doses, which are details of a single practice; the dropped claims concern other species (hybrid grouper, brown-marbled grouper, general fish, Senegalese sole/grass carp) rather than the mandarin fish cluster focus, though the practice itself is the same.

practice_en: dietary C-I20 supplementation in soybean meal diets
statement_en: In mandarin fish fed diets where soybean meal replaced fish meal, adding C-I20 (160 mg/Kg) reduced the negative effects of soybean meal: it raised final body weight, weight gain rate and crude protein content, lowered feed conversion ratio, and improved intestinal morphology (cross-sectional area, villus length, muscle layer thickness). All four claims, from one paper, are supportive, and the authors interpret the main effect as easing the rise in feed conversion ratio caused by soybean meal.
statement_zh: 在以豆粕替代鱼粉的鳜鱼饲料中，添加160 mg/Kg的C-I20可减轻豆粕带来的不良影响：终末体重、增重率和粗蛋白含量提高，饲料系数降低，肠道形态也得到改善（肠道横截面积、绒毛长度和肌层厚度增加）。四条结论均来自同一篇论文且均为正面结果，作者认为其主要作用是缓解豆粕引起的饲料系数升高。

grouping.reason: All members are the same practice, dietary C-I20 nano-antimicrobial peptide supplementation at different doses (160, 320 mg/kg), while C3604 is only a correlation analysis between goblet cells and tissue damage indicators, not about the supplementation itself.

statement_en: In mandarin fish, replacing a low proportion of fishmeal (27.27% with a mixed animal and plant protein) did not reduce growth, feed intake or survival. A higher replacement (54.55%) significantly lowered weight gain and specific growth rate and raised feed conversion ratio, possibly through anti-nutritional factors, amino acid imbalance or falling feed intake. One paper reported higher daily protein intake and protein conversion efficiency at some replacement levels than in the control.
statement_zh: 对于鳜鱼，低比例鱼粉替代（27.27%，用动植物复合蛋白）没有降低生长、摄食量和成活率；高比例替代（54.55%）则使增重率和特定生长率显著下降、饵料系数显著升高，原因可能与抗营养因子、氨基酸不平衡或摄食量下降有关。另有一项研究报告，部分替代水平下的日蛋白摄入率和蛋白转化效率高于对照组。

practice_en: feeding domestication of mandarin fish to formulated feed
practice_zh: 鳜鱼驯食（条件反射驯化）
statement_en: Most claims describe stepwise feeding domestication, moving mandarin fish from live bait to dead fish, fish chunks and formulated feed, and report that many fish come to accept dead bait or artificial feed. Reported acclimation rates were about 70-74% after 15 days across three fish sizes, and in reservoir cages taming rates were 100% for fresh fish, 100% for fish chunks and 88.4% for formulated feed in 2-year-old fish. Some claims say only some individuals accept it, and none of the claims directly measure welfare outcomes such as stress or injury.
statement_zh: 多数结论是在描述鳜鱼驯食的做法:由活饵逐步过渡到死鱼、鱼块再到配合饲料,并报告不少鱼最终能摄食死饵或人工饲料。15天驯食成功率约为70%~74%(三种规格),水库网箱中2龄鳜驯食成功率为鲜鱼100%、鱼块100%、配合饲料88.4%。也有结论指出只有部分个体能接受,且没有结论直接测定应激、受伤等福利指标。

statement_en: In mandarin fish, raising dietary protein improved growth and feed use up to a point, and then growth levelled off or fell. In one measured study, protein from 32.61% to 56.30% gave a rise then fall in specific growth rate, with the lowest growth at 32.61% and 38.10%, the highest at 48.95%, and one paper reporting higher feed efficiency and protein conversion at higher protein.
statement_zh: 对鳜鱼来说，饲料蛋白水平提高时，生长和饲料利用先有所改善，超过一定水平后生长趋于持平或下降。一项实测研究中，蛋白含量从32.61%升到56.30%，特定生长率先升后降，32.61%和38.10%组最低，48.95%组最高；另有论文报道蛋白含量较高时饲料效率和蛋白转化效率也较高。

grouping.reason: Both members concern varying the protein content of the feed and its effect on growth, so they are the same practice with different levels.

statement_en: In mandarin fish fed a maggot meal diet (replacing fish meal), adding taurine raised expression of the appetite genes npy and ghrelin and was reported to restore normal feeding levels and promote feeding, without growth or feed use being affected by the fish meal replacement. Much of the explanation (neural signalling, taste palatability, energy metabolism) comes from background literature, and the paper notes there is no direct experimental evidence yet for the taste-receptor mechanism.
statement_zh: 在以蝇蛆粉替代鱼粉的饲料中，给鳜鱼添加牛磺酸可上调食欲相关基因npy和ghrelin的表达，并被报道能恢复正常摄食水平、促进摄食，而鱼粉替代本身不影响生长和饲料利用。其作用机制（神经信号、味觉适口性、能量代谢）多来自背景文献，作者也指出通过味觉受体提高采食量的机制目前缺乏直接实验证据。

statement_en: Two papers claim, as supportive recommendations, that mandarin fish feeding should be adjusted dynamically: richer in protein and fat in the peak growth season, less at low temperatures to avoid digestive burden, and adjusted as growth slows according to weather, water quality and feeding status. Both claims only describe the practice and its rationale; neither reports a measured welfare outcome.
statement_zh: 两篇文献提出了支持性的建议,认为鳜鱼投喂应动态调整:生长旺季提高饲料蛋白和脂肪含量,低温时减少投喂量以免加重消化负担,生长放缓后再根据天气、水质和摄食状况调整投喂量。这两条都只是描述做法及其理由,没有给出实际测得的福利效果。

grouping.reason: Both members describe adjusting feeding (amount, and in member 0 also composition) in response to season, temperature, water quality and fish condition, so they are the same practice.

statement_en: Most claims, mainly reported from earlier studies, say formulated or compound feed harms mandarin fish: reduced feed intake, higher liver fat, slower growth, thinner gastric layers, less intestinal villus branching, and lower pepsin, trypsin and protease activity with poorer protein digestion and peptide absorption. One measured result adds that different feeds had little effect on muscle stress capacity but a large effect on the gut, especially the intestine, and one claim only notes that feed type affects growth and muscle composition without giving a direction.

statement_en: In mandarin fish, feeding rate affected feeding-related outcomes in a non-linear way: during domestication to feed, the domestication rate rose from 5% to 11% and fell above 14%, with a modelled optimum of 13.34%, and both low (5%, 8%) and high (17%) rates raised cart and pomc expression, read as reduced feeding motivation. In juveniles, growth and feed intake did not differ between 100% satiation and about 80–90% satiation, but fell at 75% and 70%, and body composition and most blood measures were unaffected, with total cholesterol tending to fall at lower ratios; some claims disagree on exact thresholds, and S083 also mentions S. scherzeri.
statement_zh: 鳜鱼的投喂率对摄食相关指标的影响不是线性的:在驯食过程中,驯化率在5%至11%投喂率时上升,超过14%后下降,模型得出最适投喂率为13.34%;投喂率过低(5%、8%)或过高(17%)都会升高cart和pomc表达,提示摄食欲望下降。幼鱼试验中,饱食100%与约80%~90%饱食度相比,增重和摄食量差异不显著,但75%和70%时明显下降;体成分和大多数血液指标不受影响,总胆固醇随投喂比例降低有下降趋势;不同指标的阈值说法不完全一致,且S083中还提到了斑鳜(S. scherzeri)。

statement_en: In mandarin fish, raising dietary fishmeal improved growth and feed efficiency: one paper found the best results at 50% fishmeal in both one- and two-year-old fish, and another found the best diet was a commercial feed with 45% fishmeal or 50% smelt added, which raised protein to 56%. statement_en: In mandarin fish, replacing fishmeal with 18% maggot meal significantly lowered the feeding rate, while adding taurine brought feeding rate back to the control level and shifted appetite-related gene expression toward higher feeding drive. Weight gain and feed conversion ratio did not differ significantly from the control, and the authors found no significant negative effect on growth or muscle quality.
statement_zh: 在鳜鱼中，用18%蝇蛆粉替代鱼粉会显著降低摄食率，而添加牛磺酸后摄食率恢复到对照组水平，同时促食欲基因表达上调、抑食欲基因下调。增重率和饲料系数与对照组相比差异不显著，作者认为对生长和肌肉品质没有显著的不良影响。

practice_zh: 植物乳杆菌益生菌添加
statement_en: In one study of mandarin fish with feeding problems on pelleted feed, adding Lactobacillus plantarum (tested alongside L. rhamnosus and Clostridium butyricum) improved pellet feed acceptance and survival compared with the same diet without probiotics. It also reversed the pellet-induced drop in brain agrp expression and in serum lysozyme and IgM; the link to appetite and gut microbiota is the authors' inference.
statement_zh: 在一项针对鳜鱼颗粒饲料摄食障碍的研究中,添加植物乳杆菌(与鼠李糖乳杆菌、丁酸梭菌一同试验)后,与不加益生菌的同一饲料组相比,颗粒饲料接受率和存活率均有提高。它还逆转了颗粒饲料引起的脑内agrp表达以及血清溶菌酶和IgM的下降;其与食欲和肠道菌群调节的关联是作者的推断。

practice_en: rapeseed meal replacement of fish meal in diet
statement_en: In mandarin fish, replacing fish meal with rapeseed meal worsened feeding outcomes, though the pattern differed by level. The low-level diet reduced feed intake (with suppressed liver and fat lipid metabolism) without raising feed conversion ratio, while the high-level diet did not clearly change feed intake but raised feed conversion ratio, lowered condition factor and altered appetite-gene expression, which the authors link to poor palatability and poor feed utilisation.
statement_zh: 在鲆鳜(鳜鱼)饲料中用菜籽粕替代鱼粉,对摄食有不利影响,但低、高替代水平表现不同:低水平组摄食量下降,并伴随肝脏和内脏脂肪脂质代谢受抑,但饵料系数无明显变化;高水平组摄食量未见明显改变,但饵料系数显著升高、肥满度降低,食欲相关基因表达也有变化,作者认为这与菜籽粕适口性差、鱼体饲料利用能力差有关。

grouping.reason: All three members are the same practice of replacing fish meal with rapeseed meal at different inclusion levels (high, low), and only C0165, a generic comparison to grass carp and shrimp, does not address the practice itself.

statement_en: In mandarin fish, replacing fish meal with soy protein concentrate hydrolysate worsened feeding-related outcomes: as the replacement level rose, feed intake, feed efficiency, protein efficiency and protein retention all fell linearly, and pept2 expression dropped once replacement passed 37.16%. Results on gut and liver were mixed, with more liver lipid accumulation but the greatest midgut villus length and muscle layer thickness in the FM35 group.

grouping.reason: All three members describe the same practice of replacing dietary fish meal with soy protein concentrate hydrolysate in mandarin fish, differing only in replacement level (high-level, FM35 group).

practice_en: starvation direct training to compound feed
statement_en: Both claims report that direct starvation training of mandarin fish onto compound feed worked poorly. In one study the fish showed no feeding response at first, with deaths or disappearances and regurgitation, and began eating compound feed only on day 14. In the other, the fish reacted to fish chunks and compound feed but did not eat, so the domestication rate was zero.
statement_zh: 两项研究都显示,鳜直接饥饿驯化投喂配合饲料的效果不好。一项研究中,鱼起初没有摄食反应,出现死亡或失踪以及吐料现象,到第14天才开始正式摄食配合饲料;另一项研究中,鱼对鱼肉块和配合饲料有反应但不摄食,驯化率为零。

statement_en: Across these claims, antibiotic treatment is described as effective against bacterial disease in mandarin fish, particularly Nocardia infection, where susceptibility testing found several drugs effective (enrofloxacin and doxycycline suggested first, florfenicol and sulfamethoxazole as alternatives), and early-stage treatment is advised. The claims are supportive throughout with no disagreement, but they mostly describe drug susceptibility and recommended regimens rather than measured welfare outcomes in fish, and continued monitoring for resistance is advised.
statement_zh: 这些结论一致认为,抗生素对鳜的细菌性疾病有效,尤其是诺卡氏菌感染:药敏结果显示多种药物敏感,首选恩诺沙星和多西环素,氟苯尼考和磺胺甲噁唑可作替代,并建议在细菌病早期用药。各条结论均为支持,没有分歧,但大多只是在讲药敏结果和推荐用药方案,并没有直接测定鱼的福利指标,同时还建议持续监测耐药性的发展。
